name: refund_actor
description: ACTOR for the refund/support loop. Looks up the account+order (worker), an LLM decides the action (issue_refund | escalate | request_info), and on issue_refund a worker writes the refund to the ledger. Uses verification feedback to correct a wrong decision.

messages.message: You are a customer-support refund agent. Choose the single best action and follow the refund policy EXACTLY. Respond with valid JSON only, no markdown fences: {"action": "issue_refund" or "escalate" or "request_info", "amount": number (0 if not refunding; never exceed the order total), "reason": "short internal reason", "message": "customer-facing reply"}. If a verification step's feedback is provided below, your previous decision FAILED verification — correct it precisely. Start with { and end with }.

inputParameters.expression: (function(){ var o={action:'escalate',amount:0,reason:'',message:''}; function take(p){ if(p.action)o.action=(''+p.action).toLowerCase().trim(); if(p.amount!=null){var a=Number(p.amount); if(!isNaN(a))o.amount=a;} if(p.reason!=null)o.reason=''+p.reason; if(p.message!=null)o.message=''+p.message; } var v=$.actionText; if(v!=null && typeof v==='object'){ take(v); return o; } var t=''+(v||''); t=t.replace(/```json/gi,'').replace(/```/g,''); var s=t.indexOf('{'); var e=t.lastIndexOf('}'); var parsed=null; if(s>=0&&e>s){ try{ parsed=JSON.parse(t.substring(s,e+1)); }catch(err){ parsed=null; } } if(parsed){ take(parsed); } else { var low=t.toLowerCase(); if(low.indexOf('issue_refund')>=0)o.action='issue_refund'; else if(low.indexOf('request_info')>=0)o.action='request_info'; else if(low.indexOf('escalate')>=0)o.action='escalate'; var i=low.indexOf('amount'); if(i>=0){ var c=i+6; while(c<t.length){ var ch=t.charAt(c); if(ch===':'||ch==='='){c++;break;} c++; } var r=t.substring(c); var m=''; for(var k=0;k<r.length;k++){ var ch2=r.charAt(k); if((ch2>='0'&&ch2<='9')||ch2==='.'){m+=ch2;} else if(m.length>0){break;} else if(ch2===' '){continue;} else {break;} } if(m.length)o.amount=Number(m); } } return o; })();

(function(){ var rid=$.refundId; if(typeof rid!=='string' || rid.slice(0,3)!=='RF-') rid=''; var amt=Number($.amount); if(isNaN(amt))amt=0; return { action:(''+($.action||'escalate')), amount:amt, refund_id:rid, message:(''+($.message||'')) }; })();
